verdict.rationale: Modal ships an official CLI: it is documented at modal.com/docs/reference/cli, and the official GitHub repo notes it can be installed as a standalone tool via uvx.sh. An official agent skill for coding agents supports AI-native use. The evidence does not show what the CLI's commands actually cover. missing for 10: documented CLI command coverage, evidence of machine-readable/non-interactive output for agent use, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The CLI can also be installed as a standalone tool via [uvx.sh](https://uvx.sh):
Modal distributes an [official skill](./py/modal/skills/modal/SKILL.md) to help coding agents use its latest features.
